name: form-field-validation
description: Form text-field validation: categorize one entry (pass, empty_or_placeholder, gibberish, wrong_type, wrong_format, incomplete, off_topic, sensitive_data, abusive), flag it for human review, and grade answer quality. Layer 2 of laya_mcp/forms.py.
serving: Used by laya_mcp.forms.validate_field after the deterministic rules. Serve the tuned checkpoint on its own port (finetune/serve.py) and point forms at it with url=. The base checkpoint needs LAYA_FORM_MIN_CONFIDENCE around 0.4 because it spreads probability over nine categories; after this fine-tune raise LAYA_FORM_MIN_CONFIDENCE to 0.6 (measured; see the dataset README) so low-confidence answers go to review instead of being auto-accepted. needs_review uses the fitted threshold in form-field-validation.thresholds.json.
